# PDF.js 6.4.299 (legacy browser build)

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299
Distribution: pdfjs-6.4.299-legacy-dist.zip (official Mozilla release).

Only the display module, matching worker, standard font data, and licenses are included. The private lesson library renders generated PDF bytes locally; it does not send documents to Mozilla or any external viewer. This build includes compatibility support for older browser features. See LICENSE and standard_fonts/LICENSE_* for distribution terms.
